extra.final_summary: Found and fixed several data issues affecting the question. First, standardized the case of 'sex' values (MALE/FEMALE to male/female). Then corrected likely misspellings in the 'island' column (Torgerson->Torgersen, Bisco->Biscoe). Converted 'body_mass_g' from text to numeric, handling the comma in '5,500'. Found one extreme outlier in 'body_mass_g' (4,000,000 g) which was excluded as a probable data entry error. After these fixes, calculated the average bill length for Adelie penguins by island: Biscoe: 38.58 mm, Dream: 39.49 mm, Torgersen: 38.34 mm.
